comparison.objective: Extract one locked terminal; record removes exactly one chip from a packet.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid tool insertion beneath a tab and coupled withdrawal versus selective grasping within a narrow container while restraining the packet and neighboring chips.
comparison.success_condition: Chosen terminal removed with no neighbor release or damage versus exactly one chip resting on a plate while the packet stays stable and other chips remain contained. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Both are selective extraction, but the record lacks lock release and tests containment-sensitive picking; the candidate adds a meaningfully different retained-part mechanism.
